name: @blackbelt-technology/pi-dashboard-blender
description: Headless Blender for pi agents without a native install: runs the published Blender WebAssembly build inside Node, provisions one integrity-pinned runtime on first use, and exposes it as a sandboxed stdio MCP server (blender-wasm) with a project-root-conf
